description:
Render segment images and clips, the biggest spend in the video:
always run it with dry_run=true first and get the user's yes on the
estimate.

generate: without segment_numbers, everything not yet rendered (items
rendering are skipped); with them, those segments, finished renders
included, e.g. the first minute before the whole video. Overrides need
segment_numbers and what=images or what=clips.

animate: turn one segment's rendered image into a clip; animate only
images worth motion. dry_run quotes the default clip or talking head
model. A refused render leaves the segment as it was; to go back to the
image, segment_restructure change_type to=image keep_image=true.

Check renders with storyboard_read action=segment_assets and
view_image.

action.description: generate: optional segment_numbers, what; animate: segment_number, optional talking_head

dry_run.description: Return the count and credit estimate; start nothing

editable_sections.description: Template prompt section overrides, keyed by section id

model.description: Model id (get_generation_options); omit for the saved choice

segment_numbers.description: generate: only these segments, finished ones included; omit for everything not yet rendered

settings.description: Model settings: keys of its settings_schema

talking_head.description: animate: true for a talking head (the person in the image speaks the narration with lip sync, billed on the segment's full length); false for a clip

what.description: generate: images (everything but clips: images, overlay segments, real photos, B-roll), clips, or all

name: render
title: Render segments
